xna-type.name: GraphicsDeviceCapabilities.LineCaps
xna-type.summary: Represents the capabilities for line-drawing primitives.

property.name: SupportsAlphaCompare
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports alpha-test comparisons.
property.value: true if the device supports alpha-test comparisons; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsAntiAlias
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports antialiased lines.
property.value: true if the device supports antialiased lines; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsBlend
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports source blending.
property.value: true if the device supports source blending; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsDepthBufferTest
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports depth buffer comparisons.
property.value: true if the device supports depth buffer comparisons; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsFog
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports fog.
property.value: true if the device supports fog; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsTextureMapping
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports texture mapping.
property.value: true if the device supports texture mapping; false otherwise.
